nodes.label: Backup Iron Law
nodes.rationale: Before modifying any system-level file (rules/, memory/, CLAUDE.md, scheduled_tasks.json, skills/ config), a complete timestamped backup must be created. This is the operationalization of fat-tail safety (铁律5) — AI agents modifying their own operating system is the highest-risk operation, and backup is the only effective defense against power-law distributed failure.

nodes.label: System Self-Modification Risk
nodes.rationale: AI agent modifying its own operating system (rules, config, memory) is the highest-risk operation class, analogous to surgery requiring a backup blood supply. Failures in this domain follow a power-law distribution where a single mistake can render the entire system unusable.

nodes.label: Clear-Save Protocol
nodes.rationale: Before executing /clear to reset context, the agent must proactively extract effective information from the current conversation and persist it to memory files. Context window overload increases model error rate (attention dilution, degraded reasoning quality), but valuable knowledge must not disappear with the context.

nodes.label: Durable Cron Requirement
nodes.rationale: All CronCreate calls must use durable:true without exception. Session-only cron tasks (default durable:false) disappear when the session ends, causing silent task loss. Durable cron tasks auto-expire after 7 days and need weekly self-renewal.

nodes.label: Windows Task BAT Wrapper
nodes.rationale: Windows scheduled tasks must be wrapped in .bat files that use cd /d to set the working directory, because the Windows Task Scheduler runs with an empty WorkingDirectory by default, causing FILE NOT FOUND errors.

nodes.label: Three-Source Cross-Verification
nodes.rationale: Before any portfolio analysis, holdings data must be cross-verified across three independent sources: data/portfolio.json, memory/user/portfolio.md, and the latest strategy file. Discrepancies must be reported to the user for confirmation. memory/user/ is the most authoritative source.

nodes.label: Data Traceability Requirement
nodes.rationale: All stock analysis must be based on traceable, verifiable real data. Every data point must cite its source (MCP tool name, date). Unverifiable data must not be used. Analysis must reflect real market feedback without美化 (beautification) or guessing, since the user makes real-money trading decisions.

nodes.label: D: Drive Path Convention
nodes.rationale: All .claude-related file paths must use D:\1989n\.claude\... (not C:\Users\1989n\.claude\...). C:\Users\1989n\.claude is a junction that redirects to D:\1989n\.claude, but displayed paths should always use the D: drive form.

nodes.label: Image Analysis Requirement
nodes.rationale: When users share screenshots or images, the agent must use the Read tool (multimodal PNG/JPG support) or the user-image-vision skill to analyze them directly. Saying 'I cannot recognize images' is prohibited.

nodes.label: Knowledge Application Strategy (待敌之可胜)
nodes.rationale: Knowledge from reading (22 classics, 13 formulas, 5 unifying principles) should not be forcibly applied. Instead: fill the toolbox ('先为不可胜'), wait for the right scenario to naturally trigger ('待敌之可胜'). Natural application follows 庖丁解牛 — cutting along the grain rather than hacking at bones. References Han Feizi: 以人持法 (forced application) vs 抱法处势 (architecture-guided natural application).

nodes.label: Permission Prompt Minimization
nodes.rationale: Auto-accept all tool calls unless they are destructive (rm -rf, git push --force) or pose security risks. Broaden the allowlist in ~/.claude/settings.json as new safe patterns emerge. Never ask for confirmation on Edit, Write, or Bash operations within the project workspace.

nodes.label: Post-Completion Task Check
nodes.rationale: After completing any task, the agent must immediately review TodoWrite and context for unfinished pending tasks before reporting completion. Prevents work from being forgotten when focusing on the current task.

nodes.label: Root Cause Diagnosis Priority
nodes.rationale: When tool calls fail repeatedly or are blocked by popups, stop retrying and diagnose the root cause at the infrastructure level: sandbox configuration, permission settings, network policy, file system restrictions. Ask 'what might be intercepting me?' rather than 'let me try another way'.

nodes.label: Scheduled Task Reliability Verification
nodes.rationale: After creating any scheduled task or automation, three verifications are mandatory: (1) execution status — confirm the task actually ran, (2) data quality — spot-check output for garbage/stale data, (3) dedup protection — add 5-minute dedup at script layer to prevent wasted resources from manual+auto duplicate execution.

nodes.label: Self-Sufficient Tooling
nodes.rationale: The agent must independently install needed tools and libraries (pip install, npm install, winget, choco) without asking the user. Only escalate when admin privileges are required or the operation is destructive.

nodes.label: 24-Hour Knowledge Infiltration Rule (SEL)
nodes.rationale: New knowledge or insights must be infiltrated into operating system rules within 24 hours via one of: (1) injection into rule files (CLAUDE.md, feedback/, rules/), (2) structured storage in knowledge/ with status + last_reviewed, or (3) explicitly marked as observation with reason for non-injection. This operationalizes 铁律2 (non-equilibrium steady state) — continuous infusion of information negentropy produces ordered output (rule updates) while emitting information waste heat (marking obsolete).

nodes.label: Technical Operations Ownership
nodes.rationale: Browser technical operations (F12 console, extension installation, cookie export) are the agent's responsibility, not the user's. The user has repeatedly stated they are not familiar with these operations. The agent should use Python scripts to extract browser data or use yt-dlp's built-in browser cookie functionality.

nodes.label: Token Concept Disambiguation
nodes.rationale: API token (purchased access key for services like StockAPI) is distinct from AI compute token (LLM billing unit). In AI contexts, users naturally interpret 'token' as the latter. Use 'API key', 'membership', or 'paid quota' instead of 'token' for service purchases to avoid ambiguity.

nodes.label: Existing Platform First Principle
nodes.rationale: When encountering any new capability need (image generation, video analysis, voice, etc.), the first step is to check whether already-integrated platforms have the capability built-in. Only consider external alternatives after confirming no built-in solution exists. Example: Aliyun Bailian already has qwen-image-max for image generation.

nodes.label: Fact Verification Requirement
nodes.rationale: When making factual judgments about companies, products, market positioning, or market share, the agent must search and verify before asserting conclusions. Memory-based assertions without verification are prohibited — particularly dangerous in stock analysis where incorrect claims directly mislead investment decisions.
